svg.title: Gradient descent before and after standardising the inputs
svg.desc: Contours of a least-squares cost in its two weights, with the path of gradient descent from the same relative start. With raw inputs, one feature offset from zero and the other on a small scale, the contours are long thin ellipses and descent zig-zags across the narrow direction while crawling along the long one. After subtracting each feature's mean and dividing by its standard deviation the contours are nearly circles and descent heads straight for the minimum. Each run uses its best fixed learning rate.
